Got some acrylic stuck in it. Drenched it in acetone. Stroked the brissles with more metal spatula. STILL kept its shape though i frayed, pulled, picked, and commited all types of abuse. It Picks up the perfect bead EASILY. Im a beginner and i was picking up beads like christa miken from Naio Nails. Dont know if i

Love my brush only thing I would change would be the way you place the cap back on it’s easy to get a few hair strands stuck while putting the cap back on I have other brushes that have a closure mechanism to protect the hairs in order to preserve it but I like the weight it has and how pretty it is I’ve used it four times now and has not shed at all

reviews.t: Nice brush, affordable and gets the job done.
reviews.x: I like the brush, I did crimp it myself. It's easy to use and gives a smooth acrylic application.  It arrived quickly, well packaged, damage free, and was exactly what I ordered.  I attached a picture of my work with the brush.

reviews.t: This one brush from this brand is good.
reviews.x: I read a lot of mixed reviews on this brand.  This particular brush works pretty well... They make a smaller brush that is awful but for whatever reason, this one is different.  It works well and doesn't shed.  It cleans up well too.
The packing says it's a #14 but it's really about a #8. I compared it with my Pana #8 and #10 and it's somewhere in between. But defiantly NOT a #14.

Nice brush for the price. The packaging is cute, and I love that it has a built-in cap. I was worried when I first unpacked it as the bristles were a little wonky, but the second any kind of liquid touches it, they all come together neatly and it hasn't been an issue...yet.

reviews.t: Quality product for affordable price recommend must get
reviews.x: One of my favorite brushes. Have spent so much money on buying expensive brushes from name brand acrylic companys n end up disappointed, this one is amazing n I love that it has a cap to protect your brush.  Hold shape really well. Applied acrylic n shpaes beautifully. Its hands down my go to would purchase again in fact plan to purchase in bigger size for capping.  The 10 is perfect for application but I prefer  bigger brush to cap and this is best brush I have used to date

Nice brush hasn't shed yet. Im just starting acrylics and this is a manageable size and picks up powder pretty well. Only have had it a few weeks so dunno about longevity but seems like if taken care of will last.

Good for the price but after a month use the bristles are fraying and its hard to accurately get acryllic to my cuticle without uneven spots. I'll keep looking for another but this will work for the time being.

I like the size. The bristles are not dense and the brush is not stiff enough in my opinion. I use a very dense brush when I do acrylics and I know from trying many different brushes that I don't like them to be thin and flimsy. It works okay for some applications. The cover doesn't go over the handle when using and that is a nice feature since it makes the handle a little wider for use.

Great inexpensive brush! I'm so easily sold on things because of the packaging lol. But not only is this cute but it works great. I love that it comes with a cap. Would definitely repurchase.  UPDATE: I have been using this brush exclusively for over 6 months and I love it. I've even switched to high end brand brushes, but for some reason I always end up going back to this one.

As a new nail tech who just started a few months ago, I would say that I love this brush!! I've tried many brushes to see what I like best and Its the perfect size, easy to maneuver, and its super cute. I will definitely be purchasing more!! The only thing is I don't believe its a true 14 compared to other companies, but it ended up being perfect.

I liked the design of the brush. I don’t like the way to bristles collect monomer and powder, it seems that the powder gets stuck inside of the brush instead of coming all off with the bead. It works for now, but I’ll be ordering different ones.
I got it because of the good reviews but this brush is too big for my liking. It also makes my beads really wet and it doesn’t help me shape The acrylic all that well
Am a professional nail artist and this is not a #10 brush it looks more like #6 quality is not good at all don’t waste your money buying this piece of crap

reviews.t: Don't spend your money with them
reviews.x: They didn't send nothing but the case! Do not spend your money with them at all.
It’s cute but not good for professional use. And it came bent ):
Beautiful brush and fast shipping. Can not wait to use it.

reviews.t: but so far I love it.
reviews.x: I will update when I have tried it, but so far I love it.
Haven't had a chance to use it but the brush looks nice

reviews.t: Much Better Than My First Choice
reviews.x: I purchased this and automatically saw a difference in my nails. This had a smooth application and after applying I noticed that my nail had a smoother feel to it when compared to my first attempt with my older brush. The quality of the brush truly matters and in this situation, my nails have a higher quality look even though I am not a trained manicurist. I do not have to worry about spending all that money to maintain my nails because now I can do them myself. And they are growing more consist

First time doing acrylics with this brush and it was a breeze. Easy to work with. Super cute. Acrylic did get stuck a few times could be user error it was my first time. No shedding. Would def buy this brush again especially at this price point. Also comes in a case to keep it clean.

I have just started doing my own acrylics within the last 4-6 weeks. So far this brush has been a great tool, and while I’m not a pro I have no complaints as of yet. Be sure to give it a dip and a wipe down/reshape after you use it, and you shouldn’t have issues!

reviews.t: Brush is doable but a little stiff overall
reviews.x: Cute brush. The bristles Were stiff at first but works pretty good. The acrylic didn't clump into the brush Delaying finishing a set..  However it was a little difficult to move the acrylic on the nail  bed. It was easier manipulating acrylic on the mail firms.

i love this brush. i read other reviews that it came bent but mine didn’t not come bent and it applies acrylic well. it comes with the bristles together. you have to scrape off the product on the bristles that keeps them together. love this brush so much

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brush good value for the price and a quality, affordable option.
Several reviewers praise that the brush holds its shape well and does not shed.
Some reviewers note the size is not as labeled, saying it is smaller than the stated number.
A few reviewers mention the bristles are not dense or stiff enough and can fray or collect product.
Multiple reviewers appreciate the built-in cap that protects the brush.
